t: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
I want to make sure everyone is aware that the midterm project is due next Friday.
Please ensure you have included all necessary sections: introduction, methodology, results, and discussion.
Of course, you know the introduction and methodology provide the background to the research, and the results and ensuing discussion section can give ideas for further research.
The project should be submitted through the course portal before midnight.
Late submissions will not be accepted.
